For programming under ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD, and a recent Ryzen 5/7 or Core i5/Ultra 5 chip.

Screen: a bright full HD or better display with a matte finish is easier on your eyes for long coding days.
Keyboard and battery: a good keyboard and 8+ hours of battery matter more than a gaming graphics card, unless you do games or AI work.
Upgrades: check that RAM and storage can be upgraded later, since many thin laptops solder the RAM.
Mac option: if you build iPhone or Mac apps, you need a MacBook, so check for an Air in your budget.

I can check current prices and shortlist 3 laptops once I know what you'll build. Is it mostly web or app work, data and AI, or games?
